name: The Widow's Son at Nain
title: The Resurrected Young Man
summary: The widow's son from Nain was a young man who died and was being carried out for burial when Jesus met the funeral procession outside the city. Moved with compassion for the grieving widow, Jesus raised her only son from the dead. This was one of three instances in the Gospels where Jesus raised someone from the dead.

keyEvents.title: Death and Burial
keyEvents.description: The young man died as his mother's only son. As a widow, she had lost her provider and was now completely alone.

keyEvents.title: Jesus Meets the Funeral Procession
keyEvents.description: Jesus arrived at the gate of Nain just as the funeral procession was going out. He saw the widow's grief and was moved with deep compassion.

keyEvents.title: Raised from the Dead
keyEvents.description: Jesus touched the bier and said, 'Young man, I say to you: Get up!' The dead man sat up and began to speak, and Jesus gave him back to his mother.

keyEvents.title: The People's Reaction
keyEvents.description: Everyone was filled with awe and praised God. The news of this miracle spread throughout Judea and the surrounding countryside.
